opportunities.title: [Bounty: $50] Make get_round report no recipient for a round that has not started
opportunities.description:
## Context

`RoundInfo.recipient` is documented as "`None` for a round that does not exist yet" (`contracts/group/src/lib.rs:169`), but `get_round` (`:723`) reads `DataKey::MemberAt(round)` for any round `<= member_capacity`, so a round far in the future returns the scheduled recipient while its phase is `WaitingForContributions`. The distinction the doc promises does not hold.

## Proposed Change

Return `recipient: None` when `round > current_round` (and no payout has executed), or correct the documentation and consumers to the actual semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `get_round(r)` for a not-yet-started `r` returns `recipient: None`
- A completed/current round still returns its recipient
- A test covers a future round

**Suggested Label:** correctness
**ETA:** 24 hours

opportunities.description:
### 赏金平台 / Platform
GitHub

### 原始链接 / Source URL
https://github.com/Grainlify/grainlify-bounty-agent/issues/1

### 漏洞描述 / Description
Record the real network fee in the ledger, not only the capped estimate

**The problem**

When the agent pays for inference over x402, the Solana network fee is most of what the call costs — in our measurements a paid call cost $0.002031, of which $0.002004 was the network fee. So the fee is the number most worth getting right.

The signer already knows exactly what the fee was: `res.feeLamports`, taken from the confirmed transaction. It converts that to micro-USD using `solUsdCeilingPrice`, a deliberately high fixed SOL price ($400) chosen so the budget can never under-count spend.

That conversion is the only thing kept. `inference_calls` stores `fee_micro` and no lamports, so the ledger reports a conservative estimate and the exact figure is thrown away.

**Where in the code**

- `services/signer/src/signer.ts` — `PayResult` carries `fee_lamports`; look for `lamportsToMicroCeil(res.feeLamports, ...)`.
- `packages/x402/src/client.ts` — the settle call that records the payment drops `fee_lamports`.
- `db/migrations/` — add a new forward-only migrat

opportunities.title: check_contrast.py: add --json output and a CI action that fails on contrast regressions
opportunities.description:
## Problem
`check_contrast.py --matrix` is the one part of tastemaker that is a computation rather than judgment, but its output is human-readable text only. That means nothing downstream can consume it: a project can't fail CI when a palette change breaks a text-safe pairing, and the agent has to re-parse prose to update the style lock.

## Proposal
1. Add a `--json` flag to `skills/tastemaker/scripts/check_contrast.py` (all three modes: pair, `--palette`, `--matrix`). For `--matrix`, emit every pair with its ratio and class (`text-safe` / `ui-safe` / `decorative`), plus the grouped legal pairings.
2. Exit non-zero when a pairing that the style lock marks as text-safe drops below 4.5:1.
3. Ship a small composite GitHub Action (e.g. `.github/actions/contrast-check`) that reads the palette from `.tastemaker/style-lock.md` and runs the check on PRs.

## Acceptance
- `--json` output is stable and documented in the script's docstring.
- Existing text output is unchanged without the flag.
- A PR that lowers a text-safe pair below 4.5:1 fails the action with the offending pair named.

---
💰 This issue has a **MergePay** bounty in USDC on Arc. See it on https://mergepay.fun/app#bounties

opportunities.title: [bounty] 真机对照测量：装了 MisakaNet 的 agent 是否真的更少重复犯错（要原始日志）
opportunities.description:
> 这是本轮评估（`docs/maintainer/strategic-assessment-2026-09-18.md`）得出的**唯一一个**能改变结论的缺口：
> 仓库里所有"装了 MisakaNet 的 agent 会更少重复犯错"的说法，目前**没有任何一项测量**支持。
> 现有的两个 benchmark 是占位符（`bench/self-healing/run_benchmark.py:137-140` 里
> `success = with_misakanet  # Placeholder — real implementation needed`；`scripts/lesson_reuse_bench.py:4`
> import 一个不存在的 `agents.YourAgent`），README 的 21%→43% 量的是"课程修复命令关键词有没有出现在**模型回复文本**里"
> （`scripts/benchmark_workers_ai.py:129-152` 的 `score_response()`），而维护者自己的评估写着
> 「我们对遵循率**没有任何测量**」（`docs/maintainer/setup-value-assessment-2026-09-16.md:73-74`）。

## 要收集什么

**任务级的对照数据**：同一个 agent、同一套任务，装 MisakaNet 与不装各跑一遍，按**任务是否成功**评分。

## 硬性验收条件（不降标准；缺任意一条即不接受）

1. **先写规则再跑**：任务集、每题的"成功判据"（测试通过 / 文件状态 / 退出码）、跑法，**先在 issue 里贴出来**，
   跑完不许改。改过的提交另起一条。
2. **环境写全**：OS 与版本、助手（Claude Code / Codex / …）与版本、Node 与 Python 版本、模型名与版本、
   任务集里每条任务的来源。缺任何一项即不接受。
3. **两臂对称**：同一模型、同一任务集、同一机器；"装"这一臂必须由 `npx @misaka-net/misakanet-setup`
   真实安装（附 `--report` 输出），"不装"这一臂必须是干净家目录（附同一份 `--report` 输出以证明没装）。
4. **评分对象是任务结果**，不是回复文本：不允许用"回复里出现了课程关键词"当成功判据
   （那正是现有 benchmark 的问题）。
5. **提交原始日志**，不接受人工摘要：两臂每一题的完整 transcript 与完整 stderr（可以脱敏密钥/路径，
   但要保留工具调用的时间线）。日志里必须能看出**哪一次工具调用**是 `misakanet_search`（或它缺席）。

opportunities.title: perf: 알려진 경로 재탐색과 M0 리뷰 도구 왕복 감소
opportunities.description:
## 문제
실제 모델 시험에서 일반 저장소에 devflow 자체 verify와 CI 없는 저장소의 PR/통합 커밋 기록 관례를 대상의 필수 정책으로 적용하는 결함이 재현됐다. 알려진 경로 직접 읽기와 독립 읽기 묶음은 개선 신호가 있었지만, 작은 보고 문구 변경은 일관된 비용 개선을 입증하지 못했다.
## 원하는 결과
대상에 확립된 정책과 현재 후보 근거만으로 readiness를 판단한다. 정확성 수정과 비용 개선을 분리하고, 품질을 확인한 고정 기준에서 한 번에 한 가지 비용 가설만 검증한다. Codex와 Claude 각각에서 품질을 유지한 비용 절감 및 효율 개선을 반복 비교로 입증한다.
## 영향받는 사용자·시스템
Claude Code와 Codex의 pr-review-workflow, devflow 리뷰·통합 절차 및 로컬 비교 시험.
## 제약
M0 의미 기준, M1 독립 리뷰, 필수 ignored 입력 직접 읽기, 누락 보고, 현재 HEAD 및 필수 CI·보호·승인·thread·권한 관문을 유지한다. 대상에 없는 기록 위치와 hook 역할을 만들지 않는다. 기존 실패·무효·미완료 결과와 동결 계약은 보존한다. 모델·effort·설치·가드를 바꾸지 않는다.
## 열린 질문
고정 비용 절감률 10% 또는 15%를 요구하지 않는다. 작은 절감도 호스트별 반복 방향과 비용 구성 및 실제 도구 효율로 입증되면 채택할 수 있다. 편차와 효과를 구분하지 못하면 미입증으로 보류하며 억지 후보나 자동 유료 확대를 하지 않는다. 캐시 포함 총토큰, 추정 API 비용, 실행 시간은 구분한다.
## 수용 기준
- [x] 기존 실제 도구 기록에서 알려진 경로 재탐색 및 M0 추가 왕복의 원인과 기준값을 확인한다.
- [x] 알려진 경로 직접 읽기와 독립 입력 묶음 읽기를 최소 후보로 구현한다.
- [x] M0 근거 부족, 필수 입력 누락, M1 리뷰, 최신 상태 및 CI 관문을 보존한다.
- [x] doctor와 저장소 검증 및 새 문맥 리뷰를 통과하고 후보 커밋을 기록한다.
- [x] 새 모델 비교의 입력·측정·품질·비용 기준과 명시적 실행 범위를 준비하고 실제 결과 또는 미실행 사유를 기록한다.
- [x] 검사·상태 주장을 제공 정보와 직접 관찰로 구분하고 읽지 않음·실패·명시적 범위 제한을 혼동하지 않도록 공통 리뷰 절차를 수정한다.
- [ ] 품질을 통과한 기준과 ship의 metrics 읽기 한 요인 후보를 두 호스

opportunities.description:
## What a reader hits

Every Heroku release — **including releases that carry no migration at all** — parks exactly one
in-flight request for **12–16 seconds** at the web-dyno swap. The probe target is `/api/health`, which
does essentially no work, so this is not compute: it is a request held open across the dyno handover.
A real reader whose tap lands in that second waits twelve to sixteen seconds for a page.

We deploy many times a day. This is not a rare tail — it is once per release, deterministically.

## Evidence — 3/3 migration-free releases, unattended

Captured by `tools/watch-release-window.sh` (armed detached for #2724, fires on release **START**).
Prober: one `GET /api/health` every 6 s, `curl --max-time 60`, so a parked request is recorded as
parked rather than as a gap.

## Task Description

Close the remaining P1 authority-session-loss finding from the independent complete-diff review of Frinz PR [#775](https://github.com/KestrelSovereignAI/frinz/pull/775), parent epic [Frinz #664](https://github.com/KestrelSovereignAI/frinz/issues/664) and rollout [#774](https://github.com/KestrelSovereignAI/frinz/issues/774). Core 0.53.27 is already published and verified; this is a separate canonical native contract extension, not a claim that its completed release failed.

Current native `PostgresBackend.advisory_locks()` yields no capability and observes its dedicated session again only on exit. If PostgreSQL terminates that backend, a second host can transfer ownership while cancellation-resistant work from the first host continues through other native storage connections. A cancellation request or another preflight generation SELECT cannot close this race.

## Problem or idea

Current memory_search filters live owner/project rows, constructs literal-token seeds and optionally scores/expands them with recency, importance and PPR. With no lexical seeds it returns empty before graph expansion. Existing LLM Factory embeddings do not mean memory recall consumes vectors. A reranker alone cannot recover a missing candidate. HF TEI, BAAI/BGE and newer Qwen text retrieval models motivate a bounded comparison, not a predicted accuracy gain.

## Expected outcome

Deliver a runnable, read-only qualification pilot for bounded semantic candidate generation and optional reranking of synthetic non-PHI personalization memory. Compare actual baseline, semantic candidates and ordering separately; export candidate-bound evidence supporting an explicit adoption/rejection decision. Keep production retrieval defaults unchanged until ordinary qualified adoption.

MVP mode; owning repository: AstralDeep; production Python 3.11. Reviewed current remote main: `8d82a0b48493e5018bdf81a4f59c189a8b045f6b` (2026-10-06). Relevant source seams were rechecked against the earlier research baseline. Upstream commits are investigation snapshots, not approv
